rule: The background is 4 and the shapes are colour 1. Every background cell that is 4-reachable from the border and 8-adjacent to a shape becomes 2. Every shape that encloses a pocket (background not 4-reachable from the border) becomes 8, and its pocket cells become 6. Other shapes stay 1. Pockets get no outline.
scope: Construct irregular 4-connected shapes with enclosed holes and exterior notches; recolour hole-bearing objects, fill their enclosed background, and outline only external background. Shelf placement supplies 2..6 separated objects, including open rings and diagonal-only leaks.

authored_scope:
Random mode:
- 2..6 shapes. The default count is uniform over all feasible counts, so 6 is reachable by default.
- Sides 8..30, honoured exactly when requested. Default sides are max(12, 6+3n)..30.
- Shapes are unions of rectangles inside boxes of side 14 or less.
- Holed shapes have one or two hole rectangles of side 4 or less. These can form one merged irregular pocket, two separate pockets, or a pocket walled in by extension rectangles.
- Distractors: open rings (C-shapes that stay 1), exterior notches, and diagonal-only corner leaks (still enclosed under 4-connectivity, so they become 8/6).

Placement is constructive shelf packing with full one-cell gap lines. Feasibility is decided by deterministic packing plus the bound (w-1)(h-1) >= 20n, so 8x8 with two shapes always succeeds and impossible requests raise ValueError without long retries.

Explicit mode is used by validate() to rebuild the canonical fixtures exactly. Its scenes go through the same flood-fill check as random ones: the mix and majority invariants and typed int controls are enforced.

Deliberately not supported:
- nested shapes or shapes inside pockets;
- shapes touching each other or the border;
- other colours;
- more than 6 random shapes.
authored_constraints: Background colour 4 is the strict majority of every input (shape cells < w*h/2), enforced by a box-area budget and re-checked in the analysis.
At least one holed shape and at least one non-holed shape in every scene, random or explicit; canonical fixtures satisfy this.
Shapes are 4-connected, never 8-touch each other, never reach the grid border, and never nest. Random-mode bounding boxes are separated by full gap lines.
Declared holes must equal the set of background cells not 4-reachable from the border (independent flood fill), and each pocket must border exactly its declaring shape.
Every scene has at least one shape, so the output always differs from the input (no identity pairs); empty or single-shape explicit lists are rejected.
width, height and num_shapes must be real ints (bool rejected); random sides 8..30; num_shapes 2..6; explicit rect fields are ints with sides 1..30.
Requested random size/count is accepted only when the constructive packing and the area bound (w-1)(h-1) >= 20n both hold; otherwise ValueError.
